pre_america.rule: Focal team is Atlético de San Luis in the match identifier.

america_championship_context.rule: Focal team is América and match year is 2024 or earlier.

post_championship_context.rule: Focal team is América and match year is after 2024.

limitations: partidos.competencia and partidos.fecha are empty in the source database
stage labels are contextual and do not independently prove tournament membership
coordinate direction is not normalized; PPDA uses raw x <= 72 and high actions use x >= 80
